title: Flying Buddha presents Bollywood Cabaret: Star-Crossed Lovers
description: Step into a dazzling world of Bollywood for an unforgettable evening of dinner, cocktails, dance, aerial arts, fire, and live entertainment
long_description:
Step into a dazzling world of Bollywood for an unforgettable evening of dinner, cocktails, dance, aerial arts, fire, and live entertainment

About this Event

Bollywood Cabaret: Star-Crossed Lovers brings a cinematic love story to life through movement, music, and spectacle. Follow two lovers caught between passion, temptation, expectation, and destiny as their story unfolds throughout the evening.
Featuring Bollywood dancers, aerial dance, belly dance, cabaret burlesque, fire performance, and a live DJ, this lively production blends the energy of Bollywood with the intimacy and excitement of cabaret.
Expect vibrant Bollywood choreography, breathtaking aerial artistry, mesmerizing fire, unexpected moments, and a grand Bollywood finale celebrating love, freedom, and destiny.
Purchase tickets on Eventbrite or Opentable
***Important Info: Dinner and doors open by 6:30pm guests are encouraged to arrive early to order food and drinks; the show starts promptly at 8:30pm. Tickets include the show only; There is a $25 food & beverage minimum. Dinner & drinks are available a la carte.
